court-rules.description: Court Rules - judge-level filing rules, standing orders, local rules and court holidays for U.S. federal and state courts, plus privacy enforcement actions from 21 jurisdictions. Nine read-only tools cover courts, judges, filing rules, court holidays, compliance-check parameters and enforcement actions. Hosted remote server: sign in through your MCP client (OAuth), or send an API key from https://console.courtrules.app as an Authorization Bearer header. https://www.courtrules.app/
